item.title: 'Nothing but a scratch': Kiwi in good spirits after breaking collarbone
item.description: Fin Melville Ives, after crashing out in qualification for the Freeski Halfpipe competition at the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympic games. Photo: Getty Images The medical assessments are in and it's been confirmed that New Zealand freeskier Fin Melville Ives broke his collarbone in crashing out during the qualification rounds of the halfpipe competition at the Winter Olympics.

item.title: Ireland thump England for record win at Twickenham
item.description: Ireland's Jamison Gibson-Park makes a break during his side's big win over England at Twickenham in London. Photo: Reuters Ireland blew England away in a record-breaking 42-21 victory at Twickenham on Saturday to keep alive their slim Six Nations title hopes and end those of their below-par hosts.

item.title: Uni ordered to repay $8000 in fees to student who failed course
item.description: The unnamed student failed a paper needed to get into a doctoral programme, and forfeited the course fees she'd already paid. The university has now been ordered to refund those fees. File photo: Getty Images An aspiring doctoral student who failed a paper required for her course has won an order for the university to pay her back the $8000 she spent on fees.

item.title: Two killed, three critically injured in horror Marlborough crash
item.description: A crash on State Highway 1 near Blenheim has left two people dead and three others critically injured.
